card.title: Old Reflex
card.instruction: Turn to this person first whenever uncertainty appears, as an old reflex. Notice the habit only after you have already involved them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which coat for my interview? Sorry, I still ring you before opening the wardrobe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Blue. It's still here, but I'm leaving for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can you bring it? I've made you my wardrobe department again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave it at reception. You'll have to introduce yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What should I say? No, don't come in. Just stay on the phone until they've met me.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 notices the habitual wardrobe call after making it, A3 notices assigning B wardrobe work after asking delivery, and A5 retracts an implicit need for presence into phone support.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's coat location and departure inform A3's delivery request; B4's reception boundary causes A5's what-to-say question and reduced support request.

relationship.evidence: B2 has to leave for work and B4 offers a workable coat drop while leaving introductions to A.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's independence requirement as the next uncertainty to outsource, then catches the overinvolvement.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an interview and clothing choice; B2-B4 place the coat and the reception handoff.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's do-not-come-in correction followed by stay-on-the-phone keeps the noticed habit active without an extra joke.

coach2.stated: B2's coat at B's place and B4's proposed reception drop are coherent future actions.
coach2.inferred: A1-A3 establish an old support relationship with habitual wardrobe help.
coach2.missing: No essential gap; the precise building reception is less important than the explicit drop-without-introduction boundary.
coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory defect; each uncertainty involves B before A notices the reflex.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 answers A1's coat question and identifies its location and time pressure.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 uses B2's possession of the coat to request delivery, then recognizes the role assignment.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 limits A3's request to a reception drop and independent introduction.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 asks for words in response to B4, catches the dependence and narrows it to phone company.
